title: OAuth implicit flow (universal) — review required
description: An OAuth request uses the implicit flow: response_types*=s*token. Tokens travel in URLs and fragments, leaking through history and referrers. This lexical rule flags the flow; the reviewer migrates to authorization code plus PKCE.
remediation: Migrate to authorization code plus PKCE.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the response type.
